rationale: With only 26 minutes to close, FIGR has already pulled back significantly from its intraday high of $27.47 to $25.55, sitting below both VWAP ($26.20) and the 9-EMA ($25.93), indicating the bullish momentum from the gap-up has faded. The risk/reward for either direction is unfavorable this late in the session given the wide intraday range already traversed and the elevated volatility environment (VIXY +3.84%).
